asr.full_text: Heart disease pain and weightlessness Heart disease may cause chest pain or weightlessness . With this everyone gets scared, They have known about heart disease which is be found within it for years. The day you tell about it, might kill you. Perhaps a big heart attack would affect then. That is why, we all usually get scared about whether it is a heart disease or not. So, even if it is an acute chest pain or breast pain, especially on the left side, you must take care that the heart disease exists or not. Now the question arises how to determine if he is having a heart disease, in which way? The most common symptom for the heart disease is chest pain and weightlessness. However there is one rule regarding this pain, the moment one gets tired of running it goes on to heart disease. Moreover there can be another period of time, due to sitting or not sitting weightlessness can be due to a heart attack Another reason is if you are feeling heavy on the throne, then you may also be suffering from a heart attack. But if that is really the case, then you will get a feeling of extreme pain or an increased level of agonizing pain along with it you may have a feel of sweat and feel dizzy. You will also feel very breathless. If this happens very heavy. If this is happening, heart attack is moving towards you, so two things can happen, one, due to heart disease, angina which is caused by chest pain means blockage is at more than 80% If this happens while sitting, heart attack mean blockage is over 100% so these are the chance of it happening. If pain is in your chest or chest is spondylitis how you will understand that this is spondylitis or not so first let us consider other problems and this problem can be caused by spondylitis you know that cervical spondylitis also happens we call this pain spondylitis it is a pain in spond the shoulders, both the hands or body usually on the left, but on both the hands or body , it has to move towards cervical Some muscular pain can also be there, like when something hurt while pulling items It has to be excluded And, at that time if you have to treat the pain and you are in danger then you have to do a treadmill also if you have a heart attack, then you can go for two tests , this is called EKG or ECG, or any hospital usually is also called EKG.
